snippet.title: Keeper's Dissension: Unchained
snippet.description:
Keeper's Dissension is an intense war-game with grid-movement, deck building, and resource management!

Players will battle it out in this great civil war, attempting to destroy each other’s LifeForces with their powerful Warriors and any resources they may have at their disposal! With one eye on the board, and the other on the Economy, Keeper’s Dissension will demand all of your greatest strategies to defeat your enemy and emerge the victor! The game is over when you destroy your enemy's LifeForce, emerging victorious!
